rationale: The ticket fixes selectors that never match the current eBay search-card markup, so the same observable fields come back empty against real pages. Production already exposes ListingSummary.Condition, PrimaryImageUrl and BuyingFormat, so no production surface is declared; the contract only pins the real-markup outcomes. Five fixtures use cards shaped like the live capture the ticket describes: a `li.s-card[data-viewport]` whose condition sits in `s-card__subtitle` inside `s-card__subtitle-row`, whose image is an `img` inside a `s-card__image` container using an `i.ebayimg.com` url, and whose buying format is the `Buy It Now`/`Auction` marker in an `s-card__attribute-row`. At base the parser queries only `.s-card__condition`, `img.s-card__image` and `.s-card__buying-format`, so the three field assertions fail because the values are null, not because of build, format or setup breakage. ConditionReadFromCardSubtitleRowTests pins condition, PrimaryImageReadFromCardImageContainerTests pins the image, BuyingFormatReadFromCardFormatMarkerTests pins Buy It Now and Auction, AbsentCardAttributesStayAbsentTests pins that a card carrying none of the fields still parses and stores them as null (it is green at base, which is expected for a guard criterion), and RealCardMarkupExtractsAllListingAttributesTests pins all three at once so any extraction that stops matching real markup turns it red. testCommand names only these five fixtures, never a repo-wide gate or a coverage threshold.
